ctx.x: Now, oompha, the left hand, you play the bass and you play the right hand. Bass, left hand, right hand, left hand.

And we had a fellow named Walter Johnson and Leroy Johnson. They wasn't brothers but they would go and man, they could play. We'd go on a job. I'd be the piano player and when Wally would come in I'd ease out and he'd sit down at the piano and play and everybody would gather around him and he was a very good -- because in Everett we had a lot of people that were interested in music like the Faseoli, they were Italian people and they lived across the street from me and I used to go over there and they used -- we…
